name: Explicit three-seat request selects stacked

turns.user: For this billing change I explicitly want two semantic reviewers from different model families and one mechanical reviewer, and I accept the added cost. Name the review mode, list its seats, and state whether this mode is ever chosen automatically.

rubric: The assistant selects the stacked mode because the user explicitly requested all three seats and accepted the cost.
It describes stacked as two semantic reviewers from different model families plus one mechanical reviewer.
It states that stacked is never selected automatically.
